item.title: TAKE PART IN THE DENTON STARTUP CRAWL — We Denton Do It
item.description: Stoke’s second annual Denton Startup Crawl on November 1st highlights some of the businesses putting Denton on the tech community map in North Texas. The walking tour portion ends back at Stoke, where Denton Startup Night rounds out the evening with a panel discussion, food, and drink!
